exclusions.title: Pin GitHub Actions and enforce immutable references
exclusions.reason: CI supply-chain policy. The go.yml patch pins checkout and setup-go to commits. The two added files configure Dependabot and run the zizmor unpinned-uses lint rule. The PR body describes manual probes of action references. All three changed files concern workflow configuration.

coverage: Read the sole pull request title and body and inspected the patches for all three files. GitHub's PR detail reports three changed files.
